predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The paper asserts as a cited fact that MSK is 'the most efficient frequency modulation, which is correct [6]', yet a few sentences later it claims that simply going to a quaternary variant of the same Gaussian frequency modulation yields 'a boost in spectral efficiency of at least 46%'. If binary MSK were the most (spectrally) efficient frequency modulation, a quaternary frequency modulation could not be 46% more spectrally efficient. The optimality assertion (and the attribution to [6]) is therefore either overstated or misapplied, since it is contradicted by the paper's own quantitative result.
